classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Find and analyze representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase and NADPHX epimerase activity, then rank representative sequence candidates deterministically using available VPA tools.
assumptions: GO:0070401 is assumed to annotate ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (NAXD) molecular function in UniProt; literature_search text-mined terms will surface any corrections needed before a follow-up round.
GO:0047852 is assumed to annotate NADPHX epimerase (NAXE) molecular function in UniProt; same validation caveat applies.
IPR013249 is assumed to cover the YjeF-N domain shared across NAD(P)HX repair protein family members; cross-check against literature_search artifacts is recommended.
UniRef50 is assumed to be available as a pre-built MMseqs2 database accessible via the path 'uniref50' in the execution environment; the workflow engine may require an absolute path substitution.
Only reviewed (Swiss-Prot) UniProt entries are fetched to maximise annotation quality; TrEMBL breadth is intentionally traded for annotation reliability.
No sequence length bounds are imposed a priori; the length distribution visible in sequence_analysis output can guide follow-up filtering.
protein_qc is run on the top MMseqs2 hit as a lightweight scalar spot-check; per-sequence QC fan-out across all hits is deferred to a follow-up round once hit-set size is confirmed.
No 3D structure or backbone generation is required; this is a sequence-understanding and representative-ranking workflow only.
rank_designs aggregates MMseqs2 expanded hits with sequence-analysis context and QC scalars; ranking reflects combined homology coverage/identity signals and scalar QC metrics.

success_criteria.literature_grounding: At least 10 publications retrieved with abstracts and text-mined terms covering NADPHX dehydratase and epimerase biochemistry, confirming or correcting assumed GO and InterPro accessions.
success_criteria.sequence_harvest: At least 20 reviewed dehydratase sequences (GO:0070401) and at least 20 reviewed epimerase sequences (GO:0047852) collected; at least 30 YjeF-N domain (IPR013249) members retrieved without fragments.
success_criteria.homology_expansion: MMseqs2 search of the dehydratase FASTA set against UniRef50 returns at least 50 hits at minimum 30% identity and 80% coverage.
success_criteria.sequence_characterisation: Composition, charge-at-pH-7.4, motif annotations, and liability flags produced for both GO-derived FASTA sets via sequence_analysis.
success_criteria.qc_spot_check: pLDDT-proxy, GRAVY, instability index, pI, and polybasic-patch scalars computed for the top MMseqs2 representative via protein_qc.
success_criteria.ranked_candidates: Top-10 representative NAD(P)HX repair sequences output to nadphx_representatives_ranked with deterministic ranking scores combining homology and QC signals.

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair enzyme dehydratase epimerase NAXD NAXE YjeF
